title: Billing Reports
seo: Subscription revenue, churn and MRR reports
meta: A simple report of revenue, churn and plan counts built from your billing data. From $100, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Billing reports for revenue, churn and plans
overview: We turn your billing data into a report you can read in a minute. It shows monthly recurring revenue, new and lost customers, churn, plan counts and failed payments, with simple charts and a clear explanation of each number. We pull the data from your provider, check it against a sample, and build the report as a page in your app, a spreadsheet or a scheduled email.

pkgs.blurb: A one-page summary of your core subscription numbers.
Trends, churn and a chart page that refreshes itself.
Deeper views with cohorts and a weekly email summary.
list: Revenue by plan and by country
Weekly summary email to your team

faq: Where does the data come from?
From your payment provider, such as Stripe, and from your own database if needed. We ask for read-only access or a data export, and never request your login.
We write down each definition in plain words and show how it is calculated, so your team and any investor read the numbers the same way.
Can this replace tools like ChartMogul or Baremetrics?
For a small product, often yes. Those tools offer more, but cost a monthly fee. We tell you honestly if one of them would suit you better.
Will the report stay up to date?
The page and email update automatically from your data. If your provider changes how it exposes data, an update may be needed, which is covered separately.
